mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_parent mine INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = mine.child_id WHERE mine.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM child_parent other INNER JOIN member guardian ON guardian.member_id = other.member_id WHERE other.child_id = mine.child_id AND other.member_id != #{memberId} AND guardian.status = 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE child SET member_id = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
